name: archify
description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
one_liner: An AI skill that turns a description of your codebase or system into a polished, animated, presentation-ready architecture diagram.
buyer: A freelance software consultant who needs client-ready technical diagrams fast without hours in a diagramming tool.
business_use_cases: A consulting firm generates a client-ready architecture diagram deck for a codebase audit engagement in an hour instead of a day.
A startup's solutions engineer builds a polished system diagram for a sales deck to explain the product to a non-technical buyer.
A new engineering hire documents an undocumented legacy system as they learn it, leaving a diagram for the next hire.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a fixed-price "architecture diagram deck" as an add-on to codebase audits or due-diligence reports.
Offer a subscription "always up to date" diagram service that regenerates diagrams from a client's repo on every release.

steal_this: Offer a $300 "instant architecture diagram" service this weekend: point it at a client's repo, hand them a polished PDF within a day.
